caption: 31-01 Broadway Associates, LLC v. Travelers Casualty & Surety Co.
citation_line: 31-01 Broadway Associates, LLC v. Travelers Casualty & Surety Co., No. 2:17-cv-06292, ECF No. 84 (D.N.J. Aug. 27, 2019)
headnote_district_ruling: Recommended allowing joinder of a nondiverse party under § 1447(e) and remanding an environmental insurance dispute. Applying Hensgens, the court found a legitimate contribution claim rather than a maneuver designed merely to defeat jurisdiction.
qualification_rationale: The adoption opinion also addressed a local split over the review standard for a magistrate recommendation that effectively destroys federal jurisdiction.
appellate_posture_note: Adopted in substance, with modifications not affecting amendment and remand, on October 10, 2019, ECF No. 91.
